known_limitations: Proposal-only lane: no feasibility measurement, no D2 novelty rho, no arm digest and no PnL exists yet; all counts beyond the P0 census (unique pair-issuers, per-sector tercile mass, dV != 0 share, both-stamps acceptance-eligible share, first/last bookable decision dates) are declared as mandatory P2 measurements with BLOCKED_DATA accepted in advance

Pairing inherits the census match-key construction VERBATIM: EDGAR Form-4 XML has no explicit amendment->original pointer, so pair resolution is bounded by the pinned originals index (originals outside the pinned 345,150-doc substrate are unresolvable-by-construction) and deterministic census tie rules; multiple amendments to one original are separate pairs (multiplicity disclosed at P2)

P2's dV != 0 population is the binding feasibility risk: 4/A amendments plausibly skew clerical (address/signature fixes), which would starve the content book - pre-declared BLOCKED_DATA path, not a design change

The 2026 resolvable tail (10 pairs) is likely unbookable-by-construction if the pinned price substrate ends at the V13 2025-07-24 reference; excluded-with-reason, never extrapolated; exact price end is a P2 re-measure

named-death honesty: the 17-entry D2 veto is expected to be lethal to this lane (v11_cadence_latency_form for P1 given the V12 0.5822/0.2085 precedent on the same document class; goodwill_bloat for both given the ng1 -0.3547/-0.384 kills); the lane accepts the kill in advance under the no-rescue rule
